# Autonoma SDK Documentation

> The Autonoma SDK automates the Environment Factory -- the backend endpoint that creates and destroys isolated test data for each E2E test run. SDKs are available for TypeScript, Python, and Elixir.

## Reading order

### 1. overview.txt
Start here. Explains what the Environment Factory is, the three actions (discover/up/down), the scope field, the two secrets, and SDK availability across languages.

### 2. protocol.txt
The protocol specification. Request/response formats, HMAC authentication, the three actions in detail, the refs token, the safety model, and error codes. Language-agnostic.

### 3. scenarios.txt
How to describe test data as a flat map keyed by model name. Every cross-model link is a `_alias`/`_ref` (no nesting), and the three standard scenarios (empty, standard, large).

### 4. adapters.txt
What ORM adapters and server adapters must do. Read this if you are building a new adapter or want to understand the adapter interface. Covers getSchema, createEntities, teardown, and the server adapter pattern.

## Language-specific documentation

Each SDK has its own docs directory with language-specific setup guides, code examples, and package listings:

- TypeScript: sdks/typescript/docs/
- Python: sdks/python/docs/
- Elixir: sdks/elixir/docs/

## Complete documentation

- llms-full.txt -- all pages above concatenated in reading order
